description: React component for visualizing and interacting with a Logical Node (LN) tree derived from IEC 61850 SCL validation results, including UI elements for tree navigation, node details, and actions.

methods.name: kindBadgeStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for node kind badge based on the kind value.

methods.name: severityHintStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for severity hint based on hint string.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.description: React component for toggle button to expand/collapse tree nodes.

methods.name: TreeRow
methods.description: React component representing a single row in the tree, with expand/collapse and selection capabilities.

methods.name: TreeView
methods.description: React component that renders the entire tree structure recursively.

methods.name: LnTreePage
methods.description: Main React component for the LN Tree page, managing state and rendering the tree and node details.
